answer: The bond is locked for 50 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. Because the echo lockup is enforced by the gale escrow, the dawn audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large swarm therefore freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants forfeit once per identity. That is 26 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
